nl_seeds: During [{start_date}, {end_date}) UTC, give the transaction count and total recorded value in wei for transactions sent by {entity}.
How many transactions were sent by {entity}, and what was their summed recorded value in wei? Use UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
{entity} sent transactions: count and total recorded wei; UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
For UTC dates starting {start_date} and ending before {end_date}, summarize transactions sent by all labeled addresses of {entity} with their count and recorded wei value.
semantics: All labeled owner addresses; all receipt statuses; value is the transaction field, not settled balance change.
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(SUM(value_wei), 0) AS total_value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE from_owner = '{owner}'

nl_seeds: During [{start_date}, {end_date}) UTC, give the transaction count and total recorded value in wei for transactions received by {entity}.
How many transactions were received by {entity}, and what was their summed recorded value in wei? Use UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
{entity} received transactions: count and total recorded wei; UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
For UTC dates starting {start_date} and ending before {end_date}, summarize transactions received by all labeled addresses of {entity} with their count and recorded wei value.
semantics: All labeled owner addresses; all receipt statuses; value is the transaction field, not settled balance change.
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(SUM(value_wei), 0) AS total_value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE to_owner = '{owner}'

nl_seeds: During [{start_date}, {end_date}) UTC, list the latest {n} transactions involving {entity} on either side.
Can you show the most recent {n} transactions with {entity} as sender or recipient? Use UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
{entity} either endpoint: latest {n} transaction rows; UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
For UTC dates starting {start_date} and ending before {end_date}, retrieve the {n} newest transactions in which an address labeled {entity} sent or received.
semantics: OR on endpoints counts internal transactions once; hash breaks timestamp ties.
sql_template:
SELECT transaction_hash, block_timestamp, from_address, to_address, value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE from_owner = '{owner}' OR to_owner = '{owner}'
ORDER BY block_timestamp DESC, transaction_hash
LIMIT {n}

nl_seeds: During [{start_date}, {end_date}) UTC, list the latest {n} transactions from {entity} to {entity_b}.
Show me the newest {n} transactions sent by {entity} and received by {entity_b}. Use UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
{entity} -> {entity_b}: {n} newest transaction hashes, timestamps and wei values; UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
For UTC dates starting {start_date} and ending before {end_date}, find up to {n} recent transactions with {entity} sending to {entity_b}.
semantics: Directed owner pair, not an unordered relationship; no token-transfer inference.
sql_template:
SELECT transaction_hash, block_timestamp, value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE from_owner = '{owner}' AND to_owner = '{owner_b}'
ORDER BY block_timestamp DESC, transaction_hash
LIMIT {n}

nl_seeds: During [{start_date}, {end_date}) UTC, rank the top {n} token contracts by transfer-event count sent by {entity}.
Which {n} token addresses have the most transfer events sent by {entity}? Include symbols and event counts. Use UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
{entity} sent token events: top {n} contracts with symbols and counts; UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
For UTC dates starting {start_date} and ending before {end_date}, count token-transfer events sent by {entity} per token address and symbol, keeping the {n} largest counts.
semantics: Transfer log endpoints, not outer transaction sender/recipient; count events, not transactions or token amounts.
sql_template:
SELECT token_address, token_symbol, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_token_transfers`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE from_owner = '{owner}'
GROUP BY token_address, token_symbol
ORDER BY transfer_count DESC, token_address
LIMIT {n}

nl_seeds: During [{start_date}, {end_date}) UTC, rank the top {n} token contracts by transfer-event count received by {entity}.
Which {n} token addresses have the most transfer events received by {entity}? Include symbols and event counts. Use UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
{entity} received token events: top {n} contracts with symbols and counts; UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
For UTC dates starting {start_date} and ending before {end_date}, count token-transfer events received by {entity} per token address and symbol, keeping the {n} largest counts.
semantics: Transfer log endpoints, not outer transaction sender/recipient; count events, not transactions or token amounts.
sql_template:
SELECT token_address, token_symbol, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_token_transfers`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE to_owner = '{owner}'
GROUP BY token_address, token_symbol
ORDER BY transfer_count DESC, token_address
LIMIT {n}

nl_seeds: During [{start_date}, {end_date}) UTC, rank {n} owners by transactions sent by all {category} addresses.
Among all {category} accounts, which {n} owners sent the most transactions? Use UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
All {category} addresses, transactions sent: {n} owners by count; UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
For UTC dates starting {start_date} and ending before {end_date}, group transactions sent by every labeled {category} account by owner, and show the top {n} owners.
semantics: Category across all dictionary owners/roles; not one named owner or token contract.
sql_template:
SELECT from_owner AS owner, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE from_category = '{category}'
GROUP BY owner
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, owner
LIMIT {n}

nl_seeds: During [{start_date}, {end_date}) UTC, rank {n} owners by transactions received by all {category} addresses.
Among all {category} accounts, which {n} owners received the most transactions? Use UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
All {category} addresses, transactions received: {n} owners by count; UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
For UTC dates starting {start_date} and ending before {end_date}, group transactions received by every labeled {category} account by owner, and show the top {n} owners.
semantics: Category across all dictionary owners/roles; not one named owner or token contract.
sql_template:
SELECT to_owner AS owner, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE to_category = '{category}'
GROUP BY owner
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, owner
LIMIT {n}

nl_seeds: During [{start_date}, {end_date}) UTC, rank {n} directed owner pairs by transactions from all {category} accounts to all {category_b} accounts.
Which {n} owner pairs have the most transactions sent from any {category} address to any {category_b} address? Use UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
All {category} -> all {category_b}: top {n} owner pairs by transaction count; UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).

For UTC dates starting {start_date} and ending before {end_date}, count directed transactions from every {category} account into every {category_b} account by sender and recipient owner, keeping {n} pairs.
semantics: Both class constraints; grouping by directed pair; no inferred multi-hop path.
sql_template:
SELECT from_owner, to_owner, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE from_category = '{category}' AND to_category = '{category_b}'
GROUP BY from_owner, to_owner
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, from_owner, to_owner
LIMIT {n}

nl_seeds: During [{start_date}, {end_date}) UTC, list every active labeled address of {entity} and its transaction count on either endpoint.
Which labeled {entity} addresses appear as sender or recipient? Give a transaction count per address. Use UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
{entity}: active labeled addresses with either-endpoint transaction counts; UTC [{start_date}, {end_date}).
For UTC dates starting {start_date} and ending before {end_date}, find all addresses owned by {entity} that appear in transactions and report the number of transactions involving each address.
semantics: Per address: self-transfer once for that address; internal transfer once for each involved address. No LIMIT to hide a second address.
sql_template:
SELECT labels.address, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.entity_labels_v1` AS labels
JOIN `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}') AS tx
  ON tx.from_address = labels.address OR tx.to_address = labels.address
WHERE labels.owner = '{owner}'
GROUP BY labels.address
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, labels.address
